description: DMR All Mines is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Department of Conservation. This service presents location, status, and other information regarding mining operations regulated under the Surface Mining and Reclamation Act of 1975 (SMARA) in California. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Department of Conservation. Its tags are CAOpenData, CNRA, California, California Department of Conservation, California Natural Resources Agency. It offers 7 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
